_note: Field Ecologist v3 (plan 10 §6.3). navBar: the field-notebook rail is on the left on desktop and becomes a bottom tab strip on phones (owner direction 2026-11-06; ui-audit 1.1.6). Module states m1-m5 come from the rail tabs. Extra states are views (look-sunrise: the view after dragging to face the sunrise) a learner reaches from the Now card: the survey stakes after choosing a design, the kneeling counting view at quadrat 1, the hand-lens close-up, and the field guide and data sheet drawers. walk-* states: places a learner reaches by walking (WASD or double-click) from the station.

extraStates.name: look-sunrise
extraStates.label: Turn to face the sunrise from the station (drag to look east-north-east)

steps.eval: (() => { const T = window.__TEST__; const d = T.world.sky.dir; const P = [50, 1.7, 4]; const R = 30; T.rig.flyTo({ target: [P[0] + d.x * R, P[1] + Math.max(0.08, d.y) * R, P[2] + d.z * R], radius: R, theta: Math.atan2(-d.x, -d.z), phi: Math.acos(-Math.max(0.08, d.y)), look: true }, 0.05); })()

extraStates.name: m3-stakes
extraStates.label: Module 3: choose Simple random, see the numbered survey stakes

steps.eval: (() => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L.app.goModule(2); L.chooseDesign('random'); L.step[2] = 1; L._enterStep(2); L.refresh(); })()

extraStates.name: count-kneel
extraStates.label: Module 3: kneel at quadrat 1 to count

steps.eval: (() => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L.app.goModule(2); if (!L.session?.design) L.chooseDesign('random'); L.step[2] = 2; L._enterStep(2); L.refresh(); L.enterQuadrat(1); })()

extraStates.name: count-lens
extraStates.label: Module 3: hand lens close-up inside quadrat 1

steps.eval: (() => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L.app.goModule(2); if (!L.session?.design) L.chooseDesign('random'); L.step[2] = 2; L._enterStep(2); L.refresh(); L.enterQuadrat(1); })()

extraStates.name: drawer-guide
extraStates.label: Module 2: Open the field guide (Field guide drawer)

extraStates.name: drawer-datasheet
extraStates.label: Module 3: Open the data sheet (Data sheet drawer)

steps.eval: (() => { const L = window.__TEST__.lessons; L.app.goModule(2); if (!L.session?.design) L.chooseDesign('random'); L.step[2] = 3; L._enterStep(2); L.refresh(); L._dataSheetDrawer(); })()

extraStates.name: walk-south-margin
extraStates.label: Walk to the south wall by the station and look at the margin flowers

steps.eval: (() => { const T = window.__TEST__; T.app.goModule(0); setTimeout(() => { const [x, h, z] = [50, 0.4, -6.8]; T.rig.flyTo({ target: [x, T.world.groundY(x, z) + h, z], radius: 6, theta: 0, phi: 1.25 }, 0.05); }, 2500); })()

extraStates.name: walk-north-hedge
extraStates.label: Walk to the north edge of the field and look at the hedgerow

steps.eval: (() => { const T = window.__TEST__; T.app.goModule(0); setTimeout(() => { const [x, h, z] = [44, 1.2, 103]; T.rig.flyTo({ target: [x, T.world.groundY(x, z) + h, z], radius: 9, theta: Math.PI, phi: 1.4 }, 0.05); }, 2500); })()
